title: Forever in Motion
description: Passengers wait for a train at Amsterdam Central Station, in the Netherlands. The 19th-century Gothic Revival landmark connects trains, buses, ferries, and trams and sees more than 250,000 passengers traveling through the capital city each day. Opened in 1889, the hub is being renovated and extended—the largest reconstruction project in its history.
translated_description: 在荷兰阿姆斯特丹中央车站，乘客们正在等候列车。这座19世纪哥特复兴风格的地标性建筑连接着火车、公交、渡轮和电车，每天有超过25万名乘客途经这座首都城市。该枢纽于1889年启用，目前正在进行其历史上规模最大的翻新扩建工程。
